m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: My Box! Give it here! You didn't look inside it, did you? Because that would be a serious breach of trust. The less you know the better.
Just know that now that I have these, um, sensitive materials back, I can finally get some sleep!
Oh yeah. There's a bunch of Gold hidden in here too. I guess you earned it. Thanks for your help, Wizard. You're all right.
Now what's a nice kid like you doing in a wretched hive like this? You owe the Baboon money too? Either way, I'm glad you're here.
Let's just say civilian life isn't the cakewalk I expected. Truth be told, I haven't slept a wink since I first escaped from Tetrus Prison.
Can't say I miss the beatings from the Boa guards, or the general stink of the place. No, I just can't stop thinking about what I left behind.
I was so focused on escaping that I forgot my Box of personal effects. It was all packed and ready. I just forgot it, even when we went back.
I don't know what you're up to these days. Tell you the truth, I don't want to know. But if I recall, you do owe me a favor.
If you can get my Box out of Solitary in Tetrus Prison, we'd be even. One caveat - do NOT open the Box. All right? All right. Good luck, pal.
I see you, but I don't see my Box. Guess that means we don't have much to talk about.
